Hello, I'm not sure if this was an honest mistake or if this was some kind
of joke or what. If it's not figured out soon, I'm just gonna do a charge
back because this feels really scammy, but y'all seem to have really good
reviews. I ordered a lucky miner and I was sent a rug? I'm hoping this was
just a shipping error from some warehouse. Please get back to me as soon as
you can. Thank you.  The A. delivery driver took a picture of me
holding them when he delivered them, the smaller red box was a ornament
delivered from Amazon for Christmas, and the big bag was supposed to be my
miner?
